bio: Bruno was baptized on 23 March 1751, son of Gaetano Ferlaino and Candida Colosimo ([R4-S1]). He married Francesca Moraca on 3 November 1777 ([R4-S2]). Their sons Nicola Maria (1778) and Vincenzo (1781) both head lines that lead to John.
